items.title: The property that a morphism induces an isomorphism of automorphism groups is independent of the chosen point in its class
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project — Morphisms of Algebraic Stacks
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file stacks-morphisms.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that for a point of an algebraic stack the property that the morphism induces an isomorphism between the automorphism group algebraic spaces of the point and of its image is independent of the representative chosen in the equivalence class of the point (author lemma at source lines 4013-4027, label lemma-iso-automorphism-groups). The proof (source lines 4029-4043) identifies the map for a base changed point with the base change of the original map along the field extension and invokes the descent of the property of being an isomorphism along faithfully flat morphisms, so that the property propagates through the class (proof lines 4030-4042). The base change identification with the descent step is the content. H2.
